title: Find customer segments and predict who leaves
brief: Standardise, compress with PCA, cluster with k-means and a Gaussian mixture, then predict churn with a bagged ensemble of shallow trees.
hints: Standardise first. Without it the columns with the largest units dominate the SVD, and the segments disappear into noise.

choose_components compares each variance ratio with factor / d. On standardised data a pure-noise direction sits near 1 / d, so a factor of 1.5 keeps only directions that clearly beat an average column.
fit_gmm starts from the k-means centres. If the log-likelihood falls, check that gmm_m_step measures each covariance around the new mean, not the old one.
oob_error must predict each row only with trees whose bootstrap sample left it out. Predicting with every tree gives an error that is too good.
